connector.name: Signaliz
connector.registryDescription: B2B lead generation, email verification, company enrichment, and agentic GTM Ops.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.signaliz.com over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the signaliz account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Signaliz API key as a Bearer token. Create one from Settings > Developer > API Access in Signaliz.
